title: Saver vs Spender: Same Salary, 10 Years Later (Money Life Simulator)
description:
Same salary, same city, same situations. 10 years later one twin has ₹21.3 lakh and the other owes ₹2.7 lakh.
Play the free Money Life Simulator and find your money personality: https://moneyviel.com/money-tools/life-simulator/

Aarav and Ayaan are made-up twins who start at 21 with the same ₹30,000-a-month job and the same education loan. We played the real MoneyViel Life Simulator twice, side by side: one saves first, the other spends first. Phone on EMI, card minimums, pay-later sales, a "guaranteed returns" scam call, a hospital bill and a car loan. Who wins, and why?
